answer: One concrete defense is a provenance-diversity attestation quorum: an agent gains standing only when its confirmations arrive from at least five provably independent clusters, where independence is scored by distinct funding origins and vouch-graph distance, not raw signature count. A single operator owns one cluster, so a thousand sybils it spins up fill just one slot no matter how loudly they pulse. To climb to the summit of full trust a swarm must recruit genuinely unrelated operators at real cost, and a flotilla of clones moored at the same wharf can never diversify into a valid quorum.
